[EN] Please Save My Brother
[ES] Por favor, salva a mi hermano
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Please, please save my brother!
[ES] ¡Por favor, por favor, salva a mi hermano!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] A job well done, soldier.
[ES] Un trabajo bien hecho, soldado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll find the key."
[ES] "Encontraré la llave."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Rescue Zebedah from the Rain Cages located beyond the barricaded hill southwest of Vindicator Basecamp.
[ES] Rescata a Zebedah de las jaulas de lluvia ubicadas más allá de la colina barricada al suroeste de Vindicator Basecamp.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Shackle Key
[ES] Llave de grilletes
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Retrieve the keys from the slave watchers around the Rain Cages.
[ES] Recupera las llaves de los vigilantes de esclavos alrededor de las jaulas de lluvia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring the key to Zebedah.
[ES] Llévale la llave a Zebedah.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "You're free now."
[ES] "Ya eres libre."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "They're safe now."
[ES] "Ahora están a salvo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the port in Cutthroat Harbor and tell Wynne about the brothers.
[ES] Ve al puerto en Cutthroat Harbor y háblale a Wynne sobre los hermanos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For the federation!"
[ES] "¡Por la federación!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Arkaius, Kaia's Sword Commander.
[ES] Preséntate ante Arkaius, comandante de la Espada de Kaia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
